build_attention_backend: build an attention backend class that extends AttentionBackend and implements forward_decode and forward_extend
run_attention_forward: run the attention forward pass with q, k, v tensors and a RadixAttention layer
test_forward_decode: test the forward_decode method of an attention backend with q, k, v tensors and a forward batch
test_forward_extend: test the forward_extend method of an attention backend with q, k, v tensors and a forward batch
summarize_init_forward_metadata: summarize the init_forward_metadata method that initializes metadata for a forward pass
